data.summary_en: T2A uses success/failure traces diagnosing failures, revising agent-harness components, validated by target-task improvement, selected-success retention, modification triggering. ALFWorld/ScienceWorld/AppWorld: T2A scores highest overall on three evaluated task agents, exceeding strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points; diagnosis-validation pipeline in Meta-Harness raises initial harness's ScienceWorld average by 21.6 points.
